neighbours.label: The opening of the sound 'fa-' (' Fab' in names, ' fasc' and 'asc' in fascicle and fascism), plus the name ' Maurice'; other first names and other words in the same slot stay quiet.
fire: The study was led by Fabio Rossi in Milan.
Her brother Fabian plays the cello.
The letters were published in fascicles by the press.
At last Fabrizio Conti wrote the report for the team.
The historian Maurice Bloch taught in Paris.
The composer Maurice Ravel wrote it.
After the war, Fascism rose in Italy.
Scholars then read the third fascicle of the work.
quiet: The study was led by Marco Rossi in Milan.
Her brother Stefan plays the cello.
The letters were published in volumes by the press.
At last Roberto Conti wrote the report for the team.
The historian Pierre Bloch taught in Paris.
The composer Claude Debussy wrote it.
After the war, Communism rose in Italy.
Scholars then read the third volume of the work.

notes: Part list, not one pattern: ' Maurice' and ' Francesco' have no 'fab' or 'fasc', and ' Francesco' read only 0.20 in probes. ' fabric' read 0.02, so it is not every fa- word. The newline and ' on' top examples are not covered.
